long_biography.plain_text:
Coral Triangle Safaris grew out of Kevin Corcoran and Yessi Sari's decision to create a more intimate way to explore Indonesia's outer islands. Before launching the business, they examined existing charter options and spent time with equipment suppliers in Miami. The result was a deliberately small-group service organised around comfort, safety and active exploration rather than a conventional large-party itinerary.

Corcoran has remained involved as the venture developed its sea-safari programme. Indonesian crew members handle the journey, while local guides introduce visitors to island communities and marine environments. The business builds its itineraries around activities such as diving, birding and village visits, with Corcoran helping to shape its view of what travelling families want.
